name: valuehub-os
description: ValueHub Valuation Operating System: bank valuation workflow, evidence vault and accounts

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/valuation-shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/valuation-shared && npm run build -w apps/valuation-web && npm run build -w apps/valuation-api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/valuation-web && npm run lint -w apps/valuation-api
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/valuation-shared && npm test -w apps/valuation-api
